name: Ganancia Real – Profit & Cost of Goods Tracker for WooCommerce
author: kloomstudio

sections.description:
Sales are not profit. Ganancia Real takes every WooCommerce order and subtracts what it really cost you, so you know which products and orders make money and which ones do not.

  • Profit per order and per product: revenue minus product cost, payment fees, shipping you paid and taxes.
  • Product costs: read from WooCommerce Cost of Goods Sold when you use it, or loaded in the dashboard.
  • Payment fees with a default for card gateways that you can adjust.
  • Stock alerts for products that will run out in the next days at the current sales pace.
  • Weekly summary by email with the numbers that changed.
  • Orders of the last 90 days loaded the moment you connect, and new orders within minutes.

The dashboard is in Spanish and Portuguese. Everything runs there; the plugin only connects your store. Your WordPress gets no extra tables, scripts or load, and nothing is added to your storefront.

En español

Ganancia Real te muestra cuánto ganas de verdad en cada pedido de tu tienda WooCommerce: costo de productos, comisiones de pago, envíos y stock, todo en un panel en español.

Em português

O Ganancia Real mostra o lucro real de cada pedido da sua loja WooCommerce: custo dos produtos, taxas de pagamento, frete e estoque em um só painel.

Free trial

14 days or 500 orders, whichever comes first. No card and no automatic charge: when it ends you decide whether to keep going with a monthly plan paid from the dashboard.

External services

This plugin connects your store to the Ganancia Real service at https://gr-woo.kloomstudio.com.ar, run by Kloom Studio, which calculates the profit of your orders.

  • Connection: when you click “Connect store”, your browser is sent to the service with your store address. WooCommerce then shows its own approval screen, and only if you approve it sends the service a REST API key for your store.
  • Order and product data: with that key the service reads your orders (totals, items, fees, shipping, status, and the buyer’s name, email and shipping region) and your products (prices, costs and stock) to build your reports. It creates webhooks in your store so new orders reach the dashboard.
  • Dashboard: the “Open dashboard” button opens the service with your store address.

The plugin itself sends no data on its own and loads nothing on your storefront. It adds a suggested paragraph about this service to Settings → Privacy.

Terms of use: https://gr-woo.kloomstudio.com.ar/terminos
Privacy policy: https://gr-woo.kloomstudio.com.ar/privacidad
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin. WooCommerce must be active, the store must use HTTPS, and permalinks must be set to anything but “Plain” (Settings → Permalinks).
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Ganancia Real and click Connect store.
  3. WooCommerce asks you to approve access. After you approve, you land in your dashboard while your recent orders load.
sections.faq:
Do I need an account?

No separate sign-up. Approving access in WooCommerce creates your dashboard.

What access does it ask for?

WooCommerce only offers read and write access together for this kind of connection. Ganancia Real reads orders and products, and the only thing it creates in your store are the webhooks that keep the dashboard up to date. It never changes orders, products or prices.

Does it slow down my store?

No. The plugin adds one admin page and loads nothing on your storefront. All the work happens on the Ganancia Real servers.

Where do product costs come from?

From the Cost of Goods Sold field of WooCommerce when you use it, or from the dashboard, where you can load them one by one or in bulk.

How do I stop it?

Deactivating the plugin only hides the admin page. To disconnect your store completely, revoke the “Ganancia Real” key in WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API.

Does it work with HPOS?

Yes, with HPOS and with the classic order storage.

Where do I get help?

Write to kloomstudio@zohomail.com.
